name: How product-truth links are generated and kept truthful
summary: The single-writer data pipeline that keeps the product-truth store self-describing: it builds one work_status map from the AC store, derives each flow step's impl_status and rolls it up into an impl_summary, inverts the authored flow->AC edges into the by_ac index, writes the product_truth back-reference onto each AC, and finally validates that no derived data has drifted from its source. Running it after any AC or flow edit is what makes 'which steps are built' true rather than hand-maintained.

steps.label: Build the AC work_status map
steps.human:
The generator makes a single pass over the AC store, building one {ac_id -> work_status} map that every later step reads from.

I/O boundary: generate_product_truth.py build_ac_map returns an in-process Python dictionary keyed by AC ID whose values are parsed AC records. No separate file/API serializes this map; the record fields shown are the values actually read.

Contract fields and examples (generated)
Consumes:
  ac/id: string (required)
  ac/work_status: null|string (optional)
  Schema: [ac](config/ac_store_schema.json)
Produces:
  No checked JSON binding documented in this direction.

Input illustrative ac projection; not an execution receipt — ac; illustrative; selected fields only; full required/defaulted fields in linked contract:

  "id": "ACD-300",
  "work_status": "todo"
}

steps.label: Derive each step's impl_status and roll up impl_summary
steps.human:
For every flow step and branch, the generator recomputes impl_status from the work_status of its implements ACs and rolls the counts up into the flow's impl_summary.

I/O boundary: Derived values are written back into the existing flow artifact; there is no new status-report DTO.

The generator also derives compatibility consumes/produces labels and the technical human suffix from io_contracts, preserving the authored narrative and avoiding a second editable source of field names or examples.

steps.label: Write the product_truth back-ref onto each AC
steps.human:
Each referenced AC's product_truth block is overwritten wholesale from its by_ac list so the AC is self-describing (which flow nodes / screens / mock data realise it).

I/O boundary: The generated parsed-YAML product_truth list is overwritten from the canonical inverted edges; authored criteria are not rewritten.
